notes.rf_erp_beta: rf 4.94% (10y UST, task input), ERP 4.2% (task input), beta 1.27 = 2-year weekly vs SPY (task input), fades to 1.0 over 10 years -> ke0 10.27%, mature 9.14% = index return
notes.shares_m: Q3'26 diluted 12,368M (release) + 53.5M for the 6.25% mandatory convertible preferred (19M pref shares x max rate 2.816/2.842, 10-Q line 1410; at 290.75 < the 355 reference price the MAX rate applies; anti-dilutive in Q3 EPS so not in 12,368) + 95M for the remaining 27.6B ATM program at ~290 (10-Q: 12.4B issued in Q3, 27.6B of 40B left) = 12,517M. SBC (6.8% of revenue) is expensed in the GAAP margin, so no further SBC share creep is added (would double count). No buybacks assumed (none in 2026; 69.5B authorization unused).
notes.net_cash_m: End-2026 estimate, $B: cash 56.3 + debt securities 118.4 (208.8 marketable less 90.4 marketable equity) = 174.7 at 9/30 (10-Q); Q4 OCF ~48, capex ~68 (guide midpoint 200 less 9M 132), dividends 3.2 -> 150.7; less debt at face 128.5 (127.5 LT + 1.0 current; Waymo's 5.0B Oct loan adds cash and debt equally) = 22.2; less on-balance-sheet lease liabilities 20.5 (operating 16.8 + finance 3.7) at a 50% haircut = -10.3 (the lease cost is also inside the GAAP margin, so a full deduction would double count; the 130.5B of leases not yet commenced is NOT deducted: it is capacity whose cost enters the 2027+ opex/D&A path); plus marketable equity at a haircut: non-SpaceX 15.2 x 0.85 = 12.9, SpaceX 75.2 x 0.70 = 52.6 (restricted, marked: Q3 loss 8.7B; after-tax ~20% + liquidity haircut); plus ATM proceeds 27.6 (shares counted above) = 105.0. EXCLUDED: non-marketable equity 135.2B carrying value (128.2B 'primarily one private company', name not stated) = $10.8/share on 12,517M, shown separately, not in the value. Accrued fines 13.8B are paid through the 2027-28 charges.
notes.rev0_m: 2026 = 9M actual 357,269 (Q1 109,896 + Q2 119,796 + Q3 127,577) + Q4 estimate 142,000 (consensus 142,357, 35 analysts, AV EARNINGS_ESTIMATES 2026-11-04; Q4'25 113,828 x 1.25; Services lapping ~2 pts and FX headwind per CFO, offset by Cloud/TPU scaling) = 499,300 (consensus FY 499,571)
notes.roic_terminal: 18%: between the ad business's historical ~30% and a hyperscaler compute business's ~12-15%; 2032 base NOPAT ~233B on ~1.4T invested capital = ~16%, incremental ~30% in 2032
notes.pe: exit P/E on 2032 operating EPS: base 19 (justified P/E at ke 9.14%, ROIC 18%, growth fading 8.6% -> 4.9%: steady state 17x, fade years ~19-20x), bear 14 (ex-growth, margin-compressed; GOOGL traded ~17x in Nov 2022, MSFT ~12x in 2010), bull 24 (12% growth exiting 2032, Cloud at AWS-like scale)
notes.g_base: 2027 +24.2% to 620B (consensus 634.5B, range 545-741B; Cloud ~200B +81% on backlog 560.8B with >55% in 24 months and TPU supply agreements whose 'significant majority' lands in 2027 (10-Q line 1670), capped by the stated supply constraint; Services +8% with Q4 lapping, AI Mode ads scaling globally); then Cloud 270/335/400/460/515B and Services +7/6.5/6/5.5/5%; Other Bets 2.5->18B
notes.g_bear: Search erodes to AI chat (Search +4%, +1%, 0, -1%, -1%, -1%), Network -8%, YouTube +6%, subs +8%; Cloud 2027 +55% (capacity, then a lab customer cuts), then +22/14/9/6/4% -> revenue 574B (2027) to 704B (2032)
notes.g_bull: Search +12% (AI Mode ads global, highest query growth in 5 years), subs +15%, Cloud 215/320/425/530/635/730B (TPU systems 'ramp meaningfully in 2027', ~100 TPU customers, Oracle/Crux partnerships), Waymo to 35B
notes.m: GAAP operating margin (SBC inside). Built as EBITDA margin minus D&A/revenue. Base EBITDA 39.5->44% (Services ~48%, Cloud to ~52% at scale, Alphabet-level AI R&D -7.7B/qtr growing). D&A from the asset base: gross in-service PP&E 454.6B at 9/30 (341.1 net + 113.5 acc. dep.), 145.3B not yet in service flowing in, plus the capex path; depreciation rate 8.0% rising to 9.5% of gross in service (Q3'26 annualized 7.4%; mix shifting to ~6-year servers). Base D&A 50.5/78/108/137/166/190B = 8.1/10.8/13.2/15.0/16.4/17.3% of revenue vs 6.3% in 2026 -> op margin 31.8% (2027) falling to 26.8% (2032). Consensus 2027 (~34%) implies D&A ~42B; the gap is the depreciation wave. Bear: EBITDA 37.5->36%, D&A to 18.5% of revenue (committed capex, flat revenue) -> 17.5%. Bull: EBITDA 41->47%, D&A to 15.8% -> ~31%.
notes.conv: FCF built explicitly per year (fcf_build_bn): NOPAT + D&A - capex - working capital. Capex base 2026 ~200B (guide 195-205B), 2027 290B ('significant increase', CNBC reading >300B is not company text), 2028 300B, then 280/260/245/240B as TPU customers and third-party facilities fund more of the build (CFO: 'offsets the need for us to prebuild facilities'). Bear 290/260/200/170/150/140 (cuts after the committed 213B due within 12 months). Bull 310/340/340/330/320/320. Working capital: TPU inventory build (13.3B at 9/30) net of payables.
notes.charge: After-tax $M (fines are not deductible): base 2027 8,000 + 2028 2,000 = paydown of accrued fines 13.8B (EU ad tech 3.5B, PriceRunner 2.1B, DMA 1.0B, others) net of those already paid; bear adds new DMA/ad-tech fines (12,000/5,000/3,000); bull 5,000. The 6.25% preferred dividend (1.19B/yr to May 2029) is inside the share count (if-converted), not charged again.
